educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: GRASP & FRICTION
missions.concept: A grasp needs enough normal force and friction to resist object load, while excessive force can damage the object or create unsafe contact.
missions.scenario: Hold a smooth object without slip or crushing.
missions.goalText: Create positive anti-slip margin without simply maximizing grip force.
missions.transferText: Adapt grip force when friction falls.

missions.title: UNDERACTUATION & TACTILE
missions.concept: Underactuated fingers can conform with fewer actuators, but tactile feedback and compliance are needed to detect contact distribution and slip.
missions.scenario: Tune tendon force and compliance so three contacts share load without losing tactile sensitivity.
missions.goalText: Balance force distribution, conformance and tactile slip detection.
missions.transferText: Reduce reliance on uncertain tactile information while preserving a safe grasp.

missions.title: FORCE CONTROL
missions.concept: Contact tasks require force-motion regulation; pure pose tracking can generate excessive force when the environment blocks the target.
missions.scenario: Press a tool along one constrained direction while maintaining motion freedom tangentially.
missions.goalText: Match the desired contact force without relying on extreme stiffness.
missions.transferText: Retune after the environment moves relative to the expected pose.

missions.title: HANDOVER & HRI
missions.concept: A safe handover combines grasp stability, human intent evidence and bounded release logic; neither visual appearance nor pull force alone is enough.
missions.scenario: Release an object only when the human has established a stable takeover.
missions.goalText: Reach a state where human takeover is supported by both physical and intent evidence.
missions.transferText: Do not release during ambiguous intent; wait for stronger evidence.

missions.title: SERVICEABILITY & INDUSTRIAL DESIGN
missions.concept: Exterior design participates in motion clearance, sensing, cooling, impact protection and service access; a cosmetic change can alter system performance.
missions.scenario: Refine a forearm cover without blocking cooling, service or swept-volume clearance.
missions.goalText: Find a visually plausible package that preserves motion, cooling and serviceability.
missions.transferText: Recover cooling/service margin after a sealing requirement is added.

missions.title: MANIPULATION GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate grasp stability, tactile/compliance reasoning, force control, handover logic and industrial-design interface awareness.
missions.scenario: Commission a hand for grasp, contact and human handover.
missions.goalText: Complete the three manipulation gate cases.

gateCases.name: GRASP
gateCases.text: Hold a 3 kg object with >8 N friction margin and grip <80 N.

gateCases.name: COMPLIANT CONTACT
gateCases.text: Keep contact severity below 55 while retaining >35 N grip capacity.

gateCases.name: HANDOVER
gateCases.text: Release authority only with intent >0.70 and moderate grip.
